title: Classic Buffalo Wings
description: Crispy chicken wings tossed in a tangy, spicy buffalo sauce, served with celery sticks and blue cheese dip. A timeless choice for wing lovers who crave heat and flavor.

title: Honey BBQ Wings
description: Sweet and smoky honey BBQ wings coated in a rich sauce made from honey and barbecue spices. These wings are perfect for those who love a milder, sweet flavor.

title: Garlic Parmesan Wings
description: Baked or fried chicken wings coated in a savory garlic and Parmesan cheese sauce. A savory, cheesy twist that offers a break from traditional spicy flavors.

title: Korean Gochujang Wings
description: Crispy wings tossed in a spicy, sweet, and tangy gochujang sauce, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. Perfect for fans of Korean flavors with a bit of heat.

title: Lemon Pepper Wings
description: Chicken wings seasoned with a bright lemon pepper rub for a zesty, citrusy flavor. A great option for those who prefer wings without sauce but still crave bold seasoning.

title: Mango Habanero Wings
description: Chicken wings coated in a mango habanero sauce for a unique mix of tropical sweetness and spicy heat. Ideal for adventurous eaters who love a blend of sweet and hot.

title: Teriyaki Wings
description: Chicken wings glazed in a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, garnished with sesame seeds and green onions. A mild, Asian-inspired favorite with a sticky, umami flavor profile.

title: Jerk Chicken Wings
description: Spicy Jamaican jerk wings marinated in a blend of scotch bonnet peppers, allspice, and other island spices, grilled to perfection. Great for lovers of smoky, fiery Caribbean flavors.

title: Maple Sriracha Wings
description: A mix of sweet maple syrup and spicy sriracha coating crispy chicken wings. Perfect for fans of sweet and spicy combinations looking for a balanced yet flavorful bite.

title: Buffalo Ranch Wings
description: Chicken wings tossed in a mix of buffalo and ranch seasoning, offering a creamy, tangy twist on the classic buffalo wing. Ideal for fans of both spicy and creamy flavors.
